title: Morpheus Oracle enclave measurements manifest
description: Pinned PCR0/1/2 measurements for one enclave EIF release; the attestation verifier compares a live attestation document's PCRs against this committed source of truth.

app_id.description: morpheus-oracle for the merged compute+sign enclave (Dockerfile.enclave), morpheus-custody for the key-custody enclave (Dockerfile.signer).

git_commit.description: Full commit SHA (or 'unknown') the EIF was built from.

image_id.description: Docker image id (sha256:...) the EIF was built from.

superseded_by.description: Release id that retired this one. Set by hand when a release is rotated out; a verifier must not pin a superseded manifest.

custody_boundary.description: Signer service URL and the six SIGNER_ROLE_*_KEY_ID trust anchors baked into PCR0. Written by build-enclave-eif.sh for morpheus-oracle releases.

vault_profile.description: Measured custody vault profile identity (schema, environment, file_sha256, required_egress). Written by build-custody-eif.sh for morpheus-custody releases.

reproducible_verified.description: True when the build script re-derived these PCRs from a second from-scratch build. Required on every manifest built on or after the cutover in scripts/check-nitro-measurements.mjs; a manifest produced with --allow-unverified must record false.

pcr0.description: Enclave image measurement (kernel + app). SHA384 = 96 hex chars.

pcr8.description: Optional signing-cert measurement; present only if the EIF is signed.
